patterns.note: The site uses a dark, full-bleed background for most sections, punctuated by occasional light-colored sections to create visual breaks and highlight specific content blocks like value propositions or FAQs.

Headings are large, bold, and use a modern sans-serif, often with a single word highlighted in a contrasting color to draw attention. Body text is smaller and uses a similar sans-serif for readability on dark backgrounds.
A primary dark blue/black background is contrasted with bright white text and vibrant accent colors (blue, green, yellow, red) used for data points, interactive elements, and key words in headings.

The top navigation bar transitions from transparent over the hero to a solid dark background and sticks to the top of the viewport after the initial scroll. The hero section's background video exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content.

Complex data visualizations and interactive-looking trading interfaces are integrated directly into multiple sections, serving as hero backgrounds, feature showcases, and terminal previews, making the product feel tangible.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-width video background that moves at a slower rate than the foreground text and call-to-action, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. The main navigation bar is initially transparent and overlays the hero content, then transforms into a sticky element with a solid, dark background as the user scrolls past the hero section. Subsequent content sections appear to reveal or fade into view as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold hero headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, often uppercase labels and readable body text, creating a clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and card-like elements, maintaining a modern and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing with generous vertical separation between major sections, creating an airy feel, while content within data-heavy sections can be dense.

standout: The site's standout feature is its seamless integration of complex, real-time data visualizations and trading interfaces directly into the marketing content, making the product's functionality immediately apparent and compelling. This goes beyond typical static mockups, creating a highly immersive and product-centric experience.
